principle: One successful mainline with direction/scenario-scoped experts. Cross-expert score fusion is allowed only when it is explicitly preregistered/selected on clean development data, independently confirmed on an untouched split, and passes a production runtime gate; unvalidated silent fusion remains forbidden.

router.selection_data: Nineteen preregistered LambdaRank configurations were selected only by 3-fold nested OOF on clean internal development; cfg_07 was frozen, then passed one brand-new untouched salted fold6 confirmation. External/revealed benchmark labels and runtime measurements never changed the ranker or its hyperparameters.
router.policy: For eligible general_merged external R2E direct queries, score both independently full-clean source models, learned-rerank their Top-100 union into a Top-100 prefix, then append the exact frozen v3 sim<0.9-router tail. Preserve prior task-specific deployments outside that evidence scope. For eligible registered external E2R auto queries, production v5 uses the independently confirmed four-expert Anchored LambdaMART V3; all special or unsupported E2R scopes preserve the prior objective-specific routes.

explicit_nonclaims: The unconditional all-query EnzGFM/equal-block + bounded-center comprehensive candidate failed its earlier material-gain gate. That historical rejection remains valid. The later R2E-only similarity-conditioned route (<0.9) was a separately confirmed v3 system and now serves as the exact v4 tail fallback; the LambdaRank v4 promotion is a still later, separately selected and freshly confirmed candidate-level fusion and does not rewrite the old rejection.

The fixed Top-2000 pair residual was jointly tested over bounded-center on a fresh preregistered development protocol and rejected; it remains independently confirmed but is not fused into the production route.
No post-hoc reuse of Enzyme-405, ReactZyme, temporal or Rhea128->141 revealed labels for bounded V3 selection, LambdaRank v4 configuration/ranker selection, or runtime promotion tuning.
